invariant: A SWEPT or CONSUMED liquidity pool must never be used as a future target.
method: Re-derives pools with the frozen findLiquidityPools over the EXACT window evaluateV2 uses (visible.slice(-lookback)), then checks every INTERNAL_LIQUIDITY target against the pool it was copied from. EQUILIBRIUM / RANGE_EDGE / R_MULTIPLE rungs are geometric levels, not pool-sourced, and are correctly out of scope.
